_meta.note: AI-safety benchmark cluster from user-provided links. HalluHard (populate existing empty bench, authoritative leaderboard-data.js), NOHARM (harmdash metrics.csv), OS-Harm, ChineseHarm-Bench (zero-shot w/o-knowledge), MPIB (D0 no-defense). Latest-models-focus applied: excluded >2yr models (GPT-4o/4o-mini) and older rosters trimmed to current-gen; non-model entries (AMBOSS LiSA, Glass Health, Human baseline) skipped. Direction via _lower_better metric suffix. DEFERRED (reliability): arise-ai.org/mast MAST composite (preview + inconsistent, needs Playwright); Giskard AgentHarm page (no results table); Nature s41591-026-04431-5 (different RCQ study, paywalled).

benchmarks.name: HalluHard (multi-turn hallucination rate)
benchmarks._note: Multi-turn hallucination rate (%, lower better) averaged across 4 domains (legal/research/medical/coding), 950 seed Qs. arXiv 2602.01031. Headline 'avg' metric = mean of per-domain overall rates.

benchmarks.name: NOHARM Overall Safety Score
benchmarks._note: First-Do-NOHARM (Stanford/Harvard/ARISE) medical consultation safety. Overall = harmonic mean of Safety/Completeness/Restraint, 0-1 higher better. 1,100 cases / 10 specialties. arXiv 2512.01241.

benchmarks.name: NOHARM Case Harm Rate (severe harm)
benchmarks._note: Fraction of cases with >=1 severely harmful error (0-1, lower better). arXiv 2512.01241 / HealthRex harmdash metrics.csv.

benchmarks.name: OS-Harm Average Unsafe Rate (computer-use agents)
benchmarks._note: OS-Harm (EPFL) — % of computer-use agent traces judged unsafe, averaged over misuse/injection/misbehavior. Lower better. 150 tasks. arXiv 2506.14866.

benchmarks.name: ChineseHarm-Bench Macro-F1 (zero-shot)
benchmarks._note: Chinese harmful-content detection, macro-F1 over 6 categories, zero-shot prompting (no knowledge augmentation). 6,000 samples. arXiv 2506.10960.

benchmarks.name: MPIB V1 Clinical Harm Event Rate (direct injection, no defense)
benchmarks._note: Medical Prompt Injection Benchmark — CHER>=sev3 under direct prompt injection, D0 (no defense). Lower better. arXiv 2602.06268.

benchmarks.name: MPIB V1 Attack Success Rate (direct injection, no defense)
benchmarks._note: Medical Prompt Injection Benchmark — ASR (sev>=2) under direct prompt injection, D0 (no defense). Lower better. arXiv 2602.06268.

scores._source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.10960  (ChineseHarm-Bench Table 1, direct prompting w/o knowledge)
